newsitem.title: USA: Alamco to be acquired by Columbia Gas unit.
newsitem.headline: Alamco to be acquired by Columbia Gas unit.

text.p: Alamco Inc. said Tuesday it has a definitive agreement to be acquired by Columbia Gas System Inc. for about $101 million, including the assumption of debt.
Alamco, an independent oil and natural gas producer, said its stockholders would receive $15.75 cash for each of its roughly 5.2 million shares, fully diluted.
The company, based in Clarksburg, W. Va., would merge with Columbia Natural Resources Inc., a wholly owned unit of Columbia Gas.
Columbia Gas said separately it will assume about $18 million of debt.
Alamco said the merger is subject the approval of its shareholders at a special meeting Aug. 7.
Alamco has operations concentrated in West Virginia, Tennessee and Kentucky.
Alamco's stock rose 62.5 cents to $15.25 on the American Stock Exchange. Columbia Gas fell 87.5 cents to $63.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.
